defect.name: existing AccountLease.run can re-enter provider after durable provider-intent publication
defect.exact_source_reason: AccountLease.run treats NotionAgentError(TRANSPORT) and httpx errors as failover-eligible, calls _switch_account(), and continues the while-loop with retry_operation when supplied. The transport evidence itself records provider_call_entered=true and response_progress_observation_complete=false, so the failure does not prove that Notion made no remote progress. If Stage-B server publishes provider_intent and then uses current lease.run unchanged, one logical exact request can call Notion again on a sibling account inside the same HTTP request before the durable intent is rechecked.
defect.outer_retry_reason: handle_openai_responses also contains an additional foreground transport recursion after AccountPoolExhausted; Stage-B must suppress this retry once a durable provider intent exists.

candidate.compatibility: Default remains true, preserving existing Agent/rotation behavior outside the Core durable-intent path.
candidate.stage_b_rule: After begin_provider_intent succeeds, server calls lease.run(..., allow_failover=False) and does not perform the existing outer foreground transport recursion. The unresolved intent remains fail-closed until exact durable finalization or a future typed PROVEN_NO_REMOTE_PROGRESS signal exists.

next: Fold V35 retention cleanup and V36 failover suppression into the Stage-B exact server/store candidate. Run local real-class retry/restart/transport/compaction/stream matrix before any Windows gate.
